link_id.description: The unique identifier for the linked dataset. This ID will become part of the BigQuery dataset name: logging_{link_id}.
link_id.rationale: The link ID is used to generate the BigQuery dataset name and has no direct security implications beyond uniqueness.

bucket.description: The logging bucket to which the linked dataset is attached. Format: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/buckets/BUCKET_ID
bucket.rationale: This identifies which logging bucket is linked to BigQuery. It determines which logs become queryable in BigQuery but has no direct security impact on access controls or encryption.

description.description: Describes this link. The maximum length of the description is 8000 characters.
description.rationale: Description is metadata only and does not affect any security controls.
description.compliant: Link for compliance audit log analysis in BigQuery

parent.description: The parent resource of the linked dataset. Format: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/buckets/BUCKET_ID
parent.rationale: Parent identifies the parent resource hierarchy. Has no direct security impact on the linked dataset.

location.description: The location where the linked dataset will be created. Must match the location of the logging bucket. Examples: global, us-central1, eu, asia-southeast1
location.rationale: Location selection affects data residency requirements and compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) but does not directly impact security controls like encryption or access management.
